messages:
Rae Kim: quick UX check 11 11 mock for rollback safety bubble — placing it as a small rounded bubble attached to the version chip (right side). On desktop it looks fine but on tablet it overlaps the version timestamp. screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/rollback-bubble.png

Jonas Becker: nice idea to attach it to the chip for locality. downside: the bubble might be clipped in narrow variant clusters. Also would it persist in history playback?

Priya - Eng: implementation note: attaching to chip is doable, but we need to ensure it's rendered after the chip in DOM for SR; can't rely on purely visual placement. If bubble is absolutely positioned, we must add aria-describedby to the chip so screen readers get the extra context.

Hector - PM: copy ideas: (A) "Rollback guarded: safety rail active" (B) "Rollback protection engaged 11 Undo available" (C) "Rollback blocked by policy 11 View details" Which communicates best? we want to make clear why rollback is prevented or gated.

Rae Kim: prefer short primary + clear microcopy on hover: Primary: "Rollback guarded" Secondary: "Safety policy requires approval" If it's auto-suggested allow tooltip: "Request approval" CTA. Keep state color muted red/orange so it reads as a soft block not urgent alarm.

Jonas Becker: visual accessibility: muted red on light surface might fail contrast for 12px text. Use a darker token for the bubble background or white bold text. Also add a subtle icon like :shield: to indicate guardrail.

Priya - Eng: a11y: bubble should be reachable by keyboard (tab target) and have role="status" or aria-live depending on severity. If rollback is blocked unexpectedly, announce assertive; if it's just advisory, polite is fine. For the chip aria-describedby could reference bubble id: `chip.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'rollback-bubble-123')`.

a11y-watchdog: checklist: keyboard focusable, visible focus ring, aria-describedby present, aria-live appropriate, contrast ratio >=4.5:1 for small text, tooltip accessible via `aria-haspopup="true"`.

Hector - PM: interaction question: if user clicks 'Request approval' in the bubble, do we show a local modal or route to the rollout inspector? Preference is inline modal (quick), with link to full inspector for context. Also capture metrics: rollback_guard_bubble_shown, rollback_request_clicked, approval_granted.

Rae Kim: micro-interaction thought: make bubble collapse to an ellipsis icon on very small widths to avoid chip overflow. On collapse, hover/focus opens full bubble. That keeps the layout tight.

Jonas Becker: timeline playback: when you rewind to a version with bubble, ensure the bubble animates in sync but doesn't block scrubber. Put bubble z-index above chip but below global toasts. Also add `prefers-reduced-motion` fallback to no animation.

Priya - Eng: technical detail: private consoles sometimes sandbox styles; we'll namespace CSS to `.rw-rollback-bubble` and avoid relying on global resets. Also max bubble width 280px; collapse below 380px.

Hector - PM: copy for the inline modal: title "Request rollback approval" body "This rollback requires safety review. Submit a request to the Platform team with a note." CTA primary: "Send request" secondary: "Open inspector". Keep it concise.

Rae Kim: ok action items: 1) I'll update comps with chip-attached bubble + collapsed icon variant + iconography + darker bg. 2) Priya to prototype aria-describedby and keyboard focus behaviours. 3) Jonas to test contrast and animation timing. 4) Hector to add telemetry events and draft copy for modal.

Priya - Eng: quick dev Q: do we want the bubble dismissible? If it's informative and tied to policy, probably persistent until policy changes. We can allow 'Dismiss' for the local session but still surface in inspector.

Hector - PM: prefer persistent by default. Add optional 'snooze for 24h' for power users. Track snooze events.

a11y-watchdog: final note: ensure aria-describedby text concatenates succinctly: "Rollback guarded. Safety policy requires approval. Request approval." Keep announcements under 200 chars for SR readability.

Rae Kim: thanks all 11 I'll upload updated Figma frames by EOD and tag the thread. :sparkles:
